title: Advancing leprosy risk prediction through identification of a whole blood host transcriptomic biomarker signature including non-coding genes
summary: The study reports a three-gene signature (SNHG5, SNHG8 and C6orf48) for distinguishing progressors from household contacts, with high reported AUC in discovery and follow-up analyses. RT-qPCR tested selected genes in a separate cohort of 12 progressors and 12 household contacts; 12 of 14 tested genes were confirmed. This is a small single-region validation and not a validated clinical diagnostic.
ai_technology: Random-forest and support-vector-machine feature selection on blood RNA-seq data identified a candidate host-transcriptomic signature associated with leprosy progression.
